race.comment: DIAMOND EYE (1) just on top. She's been good in three runs this time in, stepping out to 1400m last start at Sale when just missing. The run prior behind a very smart one in Here's Matilda reads well and 1300m from a good draw looks a lovely spot for her. SKYDREAM (8) resumes. She showed some ability last time in, getting over a touch further in the process. Watch the betting, she should run well. GUARDIAN DETECTIVE (11) is a Shamus Award filly on debut for the Jerome Hunter yard who should be ready to go off some solid jumpout form.  PICCINA (5) wasn't far away on debut at Sale over 1100m and should be better for the rise in trip.
